value.rationale: A natural open classification dimension in a 2026 geometric-return hypergraph public-goods model is the number of distinct interaction orders. The theorem supplies a sharp, order-count-independent structural restriction and the complete two-equilibrium derivative/end-level criterion, with a three-order attaining instance. It prevents mistaken expectations of unbounded coexistence multistability when order diversity increases, without extending the claim to generic nonlinear payoffs.
